fields.description: Live MySQL reads the Ingress machine over the LAN. Snapshot CSV reads a gzipped export - use it when off-LAN.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Path INSIDE the frappe container. Only used when Source is Snapshot CSV.
fields.label: Snapshot path

fields.description: The PC running FingerTec Ingress ("Natalie") and its MySQL service. Read-only credentials - CAF never writes to the machine.
fields.label: Ingress machine (Natalie)

fields.description: IP address of the Natalie PC on the CAF LAN. ⚠️ This MUST be a STATIC/reserved address. If Natalie is on DHCP its address can change on any reboot or lease expiry, and every import then fails with a connection timeout - which looks like the machine being off rather than a network change.
fields.label: Natalie IP address

fields.description: MySQL port on Natalie. 3306 is the default. (Not 4370 - that is the port the fingerprint devices use to talk to the Ingress software, and ERPNext never uses it.)
fields.label: MySQL port

fields.description: A daily nudge if nobody has imported yesterday. Never touches the Ingress machine, so it works whether that PC is awake, asleep or off - which is the point of putting the check on this side.
fields.label: Daily import reminder

fields.description: Send a bell notification when no completed import covers yesterday. Chosen over a pop-up deliberately: a notification persists until read, while a dialog dismissed at 09:00 is gone - and a daily modal gets clicked away by reflex.
fields.label: Remind if yesterday was not imported

fields.description: Who gets it. Leave BLANK to notify everyone holding HR Manager. Put one email per line to narrow it to the people who actually do the import - the directors hold the role but probably do not want a daily nudge.
fields.label: Notify (blank = all HR Managers)

fields.description: How CAF notices that somebody edited a punch on the machine AFTER ERPNext had already imported that day.
fields.label: Amendment checking

fields.description: The machine's own clock at the last successful amendment check. Taken from Ingress, never from this server - comparing timestamps written on one host against now() on another loses every row in the clock difference. Blank means the next check has no watermark and will ask for an explicit date.
fields.label: Amendments checked up to
